description: Budget a supported public observability plan from explicit billing units. Requires a provider, plan and provider-specific quantities; request count alone cannot determine the bill. Unsupported plans return correctable errors without a price.

avg_log_bytes.description: Optional payload-size illustration only; never used as billable GB.

extra_retained_gb_months.description: Braintrust Pro above 30 days: explicit extra retained GB-months; not inferred from retention days or ingestion.

monthly_billable_units.description: Langfuse: actual monthly traces + observations + scores; never inferred from request count.

monthly_extended_upgrades.description: LangSmith: extended-retention upgrade events this month, including older traces. Enter 0 explicitly if none.

monthly_ingested_gb.description: Arize: monthly ingestion volume in provider GB units.

monthly_processed_gb.description: Braintrust: provider-measured monthly ingested GB across logs, experiments, datasets and attachments.

monthly_recorded_requests.description: Helicone Hobby: monthly recorded requests; maximum 10,000.

monthly_scores.description: Braintrust: actual billable monthly score count, including explicit 0 when unused.

monthly_signal_issues.description: Arize: Signal issues per month, including explicit 0 if unused.

monthly_traces.description: LangSmith: total new traces this month, including those later upgraded.

on_demand_enabled.description: Braintrust Starter: true is required to model usage exceeding included GB or scores.

plan.description: Exact plan: LangSmith developer/plus; Langfuse hobby/core/pro; Braintrust starter/pro; Arize free/pro; Helicone hobby. No automatic plan substitution.

provider.description: Provider; Portkey has no verified current tariff and Helicone supports only Hobby.

requests_per_day.description: Optional workload denominator using a 30-day month; never substitutes for vendor billing units.

retained_gb.description: Arize or Helicone: actual retained data in provider GB units.

retention_days.description: Requested window, defaults to selected plan. Langfuse means data access, not deletion. LangSmith above 14 days requires upgrades for every new trace; above 180 days unsupported.

seats.description: Required for LangSmith, Langfuse Hobby and Helicone Hobby. LangSmith Plus bills $39 per seat; its trace allowance is per organization.
